name: DISCO eDiscovery
description: DISCO eDiscovery is cloud e-discovery software for litigation teams, corporate legal teams, and law firms to process, search, review, analyze, produce, and manage legal discovery data. Its public API is a selected-plan, read-only organization analytics API for DISCO Ediscovery data usage and review database size reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect one DISCO organization with a customer-owned DISCO API key and organization ID; agents can list available API datasets and read bounded usage-size summary counts only. Relay excludes matter names, review database identifiers, session identifiers, documents, users, review content, legal holds, exports, writes, arbitrary endpoints, and administration.

credentialRequirements.name: DISCO_EDISCOVERY_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: DISCO API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: DISCO issues API keys to eligible selected-plan organizations. The organization manager must allowlist Relay's outbound CIDR source and provide the key through Relay's encrypted credential store.

credentialRequirements.name: DISCO_EDISCOVERY_ORGANIZATION_ID
credentialRequirements.label: DISCO organization ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind one exact DISCO organization ID from the DISCO application; agents cannot choose a different organization at runtime.

capabilities.label: Read e-discovery usage analytics
capabilities.description: List available read-only API datasets and return redacted usage and review database size counts for one bound organization.

approvalRequired.label: List DISCO eDiscovery API datasets
approvalRequired.description: Return only available dataset identifiers for the exact bound DISCO organization.

approvalRequired.label: Get DISCO eDiscovery usage summary
approvalRequired.description: Return counts for data-usage change rows and review database size rows across a caller-supplied ISO-8601 time window.

blocked.label: Access identity, matter, or review database data
blocked.description: Organization identifiers, users, authorized users, matter names and IDs, review database names and IDs, review states, session keys, and row-level metadata remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access documents, review, AI, or legal hold data
blocked.description: Documents, search results, review work, tags, annotations, productions, Cecilia AI prompts or outputs, legal holds, custodians, collections, exports, and legal content remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Write, export, or administer DISCO
blocked.description: Imports, uploads, promotions, culls, overlays, remediation, exports, productions, user management, API key management, CIDR management, billing changes, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw APIs, pagination, browser sessions, or bypass
blocked.description: Arbitrary hosts, endpoints, headers, request bodies, browser sessions, cookies, passwords, provider consoles, raw payload return, pagination, polling, retries, bulk, and undocumented APIs are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded read-only analytics calls require approval; legal data, identities, documents, review work, exports, writes, raw APIs, and administration remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read-only analytics calls run directly; exact organization binding, CIDR/API-key ownership, redaction, response caps, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives fixed DISCO eDiscovery wrappers for dataset listing and redacted usage-size summary counts.
Hermes receives the same fixed DISCO eDiscovery wrappers.

providerSetup.blocker: The customer must have selected-plan DISCO API access, an organization manager must create or authorize the DISCO API key, and Relay's outbound CIDR must be allowlisted before live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Customer organization manager confirms API eligibility, allowlists Relay's outbound CIDR source, supplies the DISCO API key and organization ID through Relay's encrypted credential flow, and completes a live read-only acceptance check.

evidence.supports: DISCO documents a read-only Ediscovery API for organization business-intelligence analysis with API-key and organization-id headers, CIDR verification, 100 requests per minute per customer organization, and datasets/metrics endpoints.

The documented endpoints include /datasets, /datasets/data-usage-changes, /datasets/data-usage-changes/metadata, /metrics, /metrics/metric-reviewdb-size, and /metrics/metric-reviewdb-size/metadata; Relay uses only bounded read-only dataset and count summaries.
DISCO describes its eDiscovery product as litigation-team software for EDRM workflows, search, review, collaboration, cloud architecture, and AI-assisted discovery.
DISCO's security materials describe encryption in transit and at rest, AWS hosting, access controls, and security review practices, reinforcing the high-sensitivity legal-data treatment.

securityNotes: Relay stores the DISCO API key and organization ID only in the encrypted credential boundary; catalog data contains no key, organization ID, matter identifier, review database identifier, session key, or legal data.

Relay allowlists only POST https://api.csdisco.com/datasets, /datasets/data-usage-changes, and /metrics/metric-reviewdb-size, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, caps responses at 1 MB, and sends no runtime-selected paths.

Outputs contain only dataset identifiers and aggregate row counts; matter names, review database names/IDs, session keys, operation rows, sizes, documents, users, legal content, and raw provider payloads are excluded.

Writes, imports, uploads, exports, productions, review work, legal holds, user/API-key/CIDR administration, arbitrary APIs, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and undocumented endpoints remain blocked.
Selected-plan API eligibility, organization-manager authorization, CIDR allowlisting, credential entry, and live acceptance remain customer/external setup steps.
